WITH qc_projects AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux
  FROM scanqc sq
  JOIN projects p ON sq.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM qc_projects
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM qc_projects
),
num_groups AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as num_groups
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT 
  g.fundflux,
  g.count,
  g.count * 1.0 / t.total_count as fraction,
  g.count * 1.0 / (t.total_count * 1.0 / ng.num_groups) as ratio_to_avg
FROM grouped g
CROSS JOIN totals t
CROSS JOIN num_groups ng
ORDER BY g.fundflux
